decisions.reason: The camera builds directly on the firm's optical and electronic expertise and has maintained a dedicated market presence, so absorptive capacity and early results support keeping it.
The successful HERA mission using its Asteroid Framing Camera confirms strong technical and market learning, and the modular design aligns with existing knowledge.
The sensor suite has a dedicated page and leverages the firm's sensor and electronics capabilities, indicating good absorptive capacity and market traction.
The LiDAR sensor is only mentioned, shows weak early results, and builds less on the firm's established camera knowledge, limiting its ability to interpret and improve the product.
The radiation-hard camera extends the firm's core camera technology into a specialized but related area, and its dedicated page signals commitment and learning potential.
The asteroid camera is closely related to the successful navigation cameras and can draw on absorptive capacity from product B, so despite limited early exposure it is worth keeping.
